subject.title: feat: add GitHub Skill Sync repository preview

question: Should publisher settings replace the existing active GitHub-source enrollment path with a preview-only screen before the canonical repository-enrollment engine is available?
rationale: The branch intentionally stages a new workflow, but the decision to remove or retain the existing enrollment UI determines whether current verified publishers lose an available setup path during that staging period.

options.title: Retain enrollment during preview rollout
options.body: Keep the existing configure-public-source control available alongside the preview until a working enrollment action can be invoked from the new flow.

options.title: Approve preview-only staging
options.body: Accept that publisher enrollment is temporarily unavailable in settings and document the intended operator path and rollout window.

options.title: Wait for end-to-end enrollment
options.body: Pause this draft until the canonical engine exposes enrollment, then land one complete preview-and-activation workflow.

recommendation.title: Retain enrollment during preview rollout
recommendation.body: Keep the existing configure-public-source control available alongside the preview until a working enrollment action can be invoked from the new flow.
